tasks.title: Embed committed oracle source into IMPL leaf specs during normalize_plan (NGv2 Epic-3 root-cause)
acceptance_criteria: harness/planner/plan_normalizer.py gains a NEW top-level helper _inject_oracle_sources(plan, repo_root) that deep-copies the plan and, for each non-test_authoring task with a dict spec, parses the pytest test-file paths from the task's verification_command, resolves each under Path(repo_root), and when the file exists reads its source and appends it to task['spec']['implementation_notes'] under a clearly-labeled block containing the literal marker 'COMMITTED ORACLE CONTRACT' and the test file's repo-relative path.

normalize_plan calls _inject_oracle_sources(normalized, repo_root) AFTER the existing _sanitize_impl_verification_commands(normalized, repo_root) call and returns the result; every existing normalize_plan behavior (dedupe, module-first, vcmd sanitize) is preserved.

Inert cases produce NO injection: repo_root is None; the referenced test file does not exist under repo_root; the task is test_authoring (meta_task_type == 'test_authoring'); the task has no/empty verification_command or no dict spec.

The pass is PURE (operates on a deep copy, never mutates the input plan) and IDEMPOTENT (a second normalize_plan over already-injected output yields byte-identical implementation_notes with exactly ONE 'COMMITTED ORACLE CONTRACT' marker).

Gate green: tests/planner/test_inject_oracle_sources.py (6/6) passes AND the existing tests/planner/test_plan_normalizer.py, tests/planner/test_plan_normalizer_vcmd_sanitize.py, tests/planner/test_sanitize_vcmd_repo_mapping.py stay green (0 regressions).

spec.objective: Close the NGv2 Epic-3 root-cause: auto-decomposed IMPL-only leaf task specs DEFER to the committed oracle ('exact semantics defined by the committed oracle tests/test_<leaf>.py'), but the blind synthesis agent is jailed and cannot READ that test file, so the exact constants/schemas never reach it and precision-sensitive leaves fail systematically. Fix: during normalize_plan, deterministically read each IMPL task's committed oracle (the pytest test file named in its verification_command, resolved under the external repo_root) and EMBED its source verbatim into the task spec's implementation_notes, which the synthesis agent already sees via inbox/task.json. This turns a vague 'see the oracle' spec into a self-contained contract.
functional_requirements: Add a NEW top-level function _inject_oracle_sources(plan, repo_root) to harness/planner/plan_normalizer.py. If repo_root is None or plan is not a dict, return the plan unchanged. Otherwise deep-copy the plan (copy.deepcopy, already imported as `copy`) and iterate its 'tasks' list.

For each task that is a dict, is NOT test_authoring (reuse the module's existing _is_test_authoring(task) helper), has a dict 'spec', and has a non-empty string 'verification_command': extract the pytest test-file paths from the verification_command (tokens ending in '.py' that are not flags), resolve each as Path(repo_root) / token, and for each that is an existing file read its UTF-8 source (guard OSError -> skip).

Append the collected oracle sources to task['spec']['implementation_notes'] as a single appended block beginning with a header line that contains the literal substring 'COMMITTED ORACLE CONTRACT' plus a short instruction that the agent cannot see these files at synthesis time and MUST satisfy them exactly; for each oracle include its repo-relative path and the source fenced in a python code block. Preserve any pre-existing implementation_notes text (append, do not overwrite); if the key is absent, create it from the block.
Idempotency: if task['spec']['implementation_notes'] already contains the 'COMMITTED ORACLE CONTRACT' marker, skip that task (do not re-append).

Wire the call into normalize_plan: after the existing line `normalized = _sanitize_impl_verification_commands(normalized, repo_root)`, add `normalized = _inject_oracle_sources(normalized, repo_root)` immediately before `return normalized`. Make NO other change to normalize_plan.
spec.interfaces: New: harness/planner/plan_normalizer._inject_oracle_sources(plan: Dict[str, Any], repo_root: Optional[Any]) -> Dict[str, Any] (pure, deep-copy, file-reading; inert when repo_root is None). Changed: normalize_plan(plan, repo_root=None) now also calls _inject_oracle_sources after _sanitize_impl_verification_commands. The verification_command is read AFTER sanitization so the final 'python -m pytest <files> -q' form is parsed. Reuse the existing _is_test_authoring helper. Do not change the function signature of normalize_plan.
edge_cases: repo_root is None -> return plan unchanged (no I/O, byte-identical).
Referenced test file absent under repo_root -> no injection for that file.
test_authoring task -> never injected (it AUTHORS the oracle).
verification_command missing/empty or spec not a dict -> task skipped.
implementation_notes already contains 'COMMITTED ORACLE CONTRACT' -> skip (idempotent; exactly one marker after repeated normalize).
Multiple test files in one vcmd -> embed each, each labeled with its repo-relative path.
Input plan must never be mutated (operate on a deep copy).
non_goals: Do NOT change _sanitize_impl_verification_commands, _dedupe_oracles, _enforce_module_first, or any other existing function body.
Do NOT alter the verification_command; only enrich the spec.
Do NOT add third-party imports or use eval/exec/__import__; pathlib.Path and copy are already available.
Do NOT inject for self-builds gated differently — the inertness is purely (repo_root None) / (file absent); no other gating.
integration: contract pinned by the committed oracle tests/planner/test_inject_oracle_sources.py plus the existing normalizer regression tests; no wiring beyond the single normalize_plan call.
spec.implementation_notes:
This is a SELF build (harness/planner/plan_normalizer.py is in the JM repo) so READ the real file and reproduce faithfully. Emit the change as a SINGLE kind:'symbol' partial-edit patch via __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ named 'normalize_plan' (a 1-part qualname). Because _inject_oracle_sources is a BRAND-NEW top-level function, RIDE it as a TRAILING extra top-level def inside the SAME normalize_plan patch `code` string (PHASE_R_ANCHORED_PATCH: a 1-part-qualname symbol patch may carry extra top-level defs which the harness inserts before the primary symbol). So the patch `code` contains: (1) the full new `def _inject_oracle_sources(plan, repo_root): ...` and (2) the reproduced `def normalize_plan(plan, repo_root=None): ...` byte-identical EXCEPT inserting `normalized = _inject_oracle_sources(normalized, repo_root)` between the existing `normalized = _sanitize_impl_verification_commands(normalized, repo_root)` line and `return normalized`. Reproduce normalize_plan's docstring and existing body exactly. For parsing pytest files from the vcmd: split on whitespace and keep tokens that end with '.py' and do not start with '-'. Use `from pathlib import Path` locally (mirrors _sanitize_impl_verification_commands which imports Path locally). Header example: f"

# COMMITTED ORACLE CONTRACT (authoritative; you cannot read these files at synthesis time so they are reproduced verbatim -- your code MUST make them pass):
". Then per file: f"
## {rel}
```python
{src}
```
". Guard all file reads in try/except OSError. Keep the function pure: deep-copy at entry, return the copy.
